config.nguhroutes.debug.tooltip: Outputs debug information in chat when using certain features.
config.nguhroutes.update_notifications.t: Shows a notification in chat whenever a mod update is available.
config.nguhroutes.your_doom.tooltip: If enabled, the your_doom warp will be recommended if warping to it is faster.
config.nguhroutes.nonether_by_default.to: If enabled, interdimensional transfers are not recommended by default. Can be temporarily overridden using "/nr reload nether" and "/nr reload nonether". Changing this option does not automatically perform a reload, so a manual reload is required for this to take effect.
